name: Book of Infinite Spells
description: A minor artifact containing 1d8+22 pages, each bearing a randomly determined spell. Its possessor may cast the open page's spell once per day but risks an involuntary page turn after every use.

name: Hammer of Thunderbolts
description: A +3 Large returning warhammer. With gauntlets of ogre power and a belt of giant strength it becomes +5, doubles the belt's Strength bonus, gains giant bane, and can stun or slay giants when hurled.

name: Philosopher's Stone
description: A minor artifact whose quicksilver can transmute up to 5,000 pounds of iron into silver or 1,000 pounds of lead into gold. Its powder also enables true resurrection for 1d10 creatures.

name: Sphere of Annihilation
description: A 2-foot black globe that obliterates matter entering it. An arcane caster can move it through force of will, with opposed control checks when multiple creatures contend for it.

name: Talisman of Pure Good
description: A six-charge minor artifact usable by a pure good divine spellcaster to open a fissure beneath an evil divine spellcaster within 100 feet. Neutral and evil divine casters are harmed by touching it.

name: Talisman of the Sphere
description: Doubles an arcane spellcaster's modifier when controlling a sphere of annihilation and reduces how often control must be checked. Non-arcane creatures take 5d6 damage merely by holding it.

name: Talisman of Reluctant Wishes
description: A minor artifact governed by an initial Charisma check: it may behave as a loadstone, grant temporary access to a wish, or remain for months and grant multiple wishes before becoming a diamond.

name: Talisman of Ultimate Evil
description: A six-charge minor artifact usable by a profoundly evil divine spellcaster to open a fissure beneath a good divine spellcaster within 100 feet. Neutral and good divine casters are harmed by touching it.

name: The Moaning Diamond
description: A major artifact that reshapes up to 5,000 cubic feet of earth and stone three times per day and can summon one maximum-hit-point elder earth elemental at a time.

name: The Orbs of Dragonkind
description: Ten major artifacts, each bound to a dragon variety. An orb dominates matching dragons, grants defensive traits and breath immunity, supplies a breath weapon, communicates with other orbs, and has a variety-specific spell power.

name: The Saint's Mace
description: A +5 holy axiomatic disruption heavy mace that can project searing light at will as a 20th-level caster.

name: The Shadowstaff
description: A major artifact granting +4 AC and Reflex saves in ordinary illumination. It summons shadows or a nightcrawler, grants gaseous shadow form, and projects 10d6 cold shadow bolts, but penalizes its wielder in bright light or total darkness.

name: The Shield of the Sun
description: A +5 heavy shield that grants spellcasting as a 20th-level paladin with Wisdom 20, spell resistance 15, and resistance 10 to five energy types. Its owner owes an annual quest to a lawful good deity.

name: Everfull Purse
description: A minor artifact that replaces one gold piece left inside at sunset with twenty-five gold pieces at sunrise. It has no effect if anything else is placed within.

name: Libram of Ineffable Damnation
description: After one week of study, an evil arcane caster gains +1 inherent to the relevant casting ability and substantial experience. Other readers risk permanent drain or insanity; the book vanishes after use.

name: Libram of Silver Magic
description: After one week of study, a neutral arcane caster gains +1 inherent to the relevant casting ability and substantial experience. Other readers risk permanent drain or insanity; the book vanishes after use.

name: Manual of Puissant Skill at Arms
description: After one week of study, a barbarian, fighter, monk, paladin, or ranger gains +1 inherent Strength and substantial experience. Ineligible arcane casters risk experience loss and Intelligence drain.

name: Manual of Stealthy Pilfering
description: After one week of study, a rogue gains +1 inherent Dexterity and substantial experience. Ineligible divine casters risk experience loss and Wisdom drain.

name: Rogue's Dice
description: A pair of minor-artifact dice producing one of eleven beneficial or harmful results on an announced roll, from permanent ability loss and negative levels to limited wish or experience gain.

name: Cup and Talisman of the Demigod
description: Paired major artifacts. The cup transforms holy water into potent curatives; the talisman grants +6 Charisma and restorative spells; combined, they create a monthly elixir of resurrection.

name: Eye of the Orc
description: A major artifact granting orcs +6 Strength and Charisma and doubled darkvision. Other wielders gain +2 Strength but lose Intelligence and Charisma; all wielded weapons become elf bane, and true seeing is available daily.

name: Iron Gauntlet of War
description: An intelligent lawful-evil major artifact granting +8 Strength, doubled smite damage, +4 Leadership with restrictions, and implosion once per day.

name: Ring of Nine Facets
description: A major artifact whose randomly active daily facet grants one of nine defenses or movement powers. Its wearer can attempt to change facets through a difficult concentration check and suffers when removing it.
